descriptionHtml:
Gigabyte GeForce RTX 5060 Ti Gaming OC 16GB GDDR7 Graphics Card

Empower your desktop gaming workstation and high-end rendering projects with the power of the Gigabyte GeForce RTX 5060 Ti Gaming OC 16GB GDDR7 graphics card, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Driven by NVIDIA's high-efficiency next-generation architecture, this premium card offers a massive 16GB of ultra-fast dedicated GDDR7 memory buffer to eliminate performance bottlenecks in texture-heavy AAA titles and complex AI computing workloads. To ensure optimal thermal dissipation, it is equipped with Gigabyte's iconic Windforce cooling system, featuring three alternate-spinning unique blade fans, high-efficiency composite pure copper heat pipes, and screen cooling architecture. Built with a rigid protection backplate, premium components, and customizable RGB Fusion lighting array, this factory overclocked edition delivers ultimate structural durability and premium frame rates, officially backed by a 3-year factory warranty.
